name: mission-control
description: Local, read-only observer of Claude Code sessions, subagents and workflows.

scripts.start: npm run build && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B server/server.py --static dist
scripts.bundle: npm run build && electron-packager . "Mission Control" --platform=darwin --arch=$(uname -m | sed s/x86_64/x64/) --out=release --overwrite --prune=false --asar=false --ignore='^/(src|scripts|screenshots|release|node_modules|\.scratch|\.git|run\.log|server\.pid|index\.html|vite\.config\.ts|tsconfig\.json|README\.md|CLAUDE\.local\.md)'
